`UnifiedActivationPipeline` in `.aios-core/development/scripts/unified-activation-pipeline.js` is the single entry point for ALL 12 agents; `generate-greeting.js` delegates to `UnifiedActivationPipeline.activate(agentId)`. `GreetingBuilder` assembles greetings; pipeline preloads enriched context. `loadUserProfile()` in `buildGreeting()` passes to `_buildContextualGreeting()` to avoid double `resolveConfig()`. `GreetingPreferenceManager.getPreference(userProfile)` supports bob restriction; PM bypasses. Bob non-PM: `auto` redirects; forced `named` is simple named.

Phases: 1 five parallel loaders (`Promise.all`); 2 definition; 3 sequential preference/session/workflow; 4 context; 5 `GreetingBuilder`. Eight agents use `visibility: [full, quick, key]`; `qa`, `data-engineer`, `devops`, `ux-design-expert` have NO visibility metadata and fall back to first 12 commands. `aios-master`: `visibility: full`. Bob mode: non-PM empty commands. `*yolo
